# Muhammed Abdulhadi
Full-stack developer based in Lagos, Nigeria. Open to junior full-stack roles and freelance collaborations.
Portfolio: https://mrglasswillbreak.vercel.app
## Selected work
- [TurnRight](https://mrglasswillbreak.vercel.app/projects/turnright): Independent multi-campus GIS and navigation platform for LASU Ojo and UNILAG Akoka, with walking/driving routes, verified offline packages, 3D buildings, and a private team editor. Routes and entrances still require field verification.
- [RJWF](https://mrglasswillbreak.vercel.app/projects/rjwf): RemmyJ Wellness Foundation website, guided content studio, and private submissions inbox.
- [Photography Portfolio](https://mrglasswillbreak.vercel.app/projects/photography-portfolio): Photography website with a gallery, CMS, and first-party analytics.
- [Fidarsi](https://mrglasswillbreak.vercel.app/projects/fidarsi): Corporate website and registration platform.
- [KinSous](https://mrglasswillbreak.vercel.app/projects/kinsous): Culinary marketplace with bidding, private messaging, order milestones, payment workflows, and a PWA. Live payments require provider setup and approval.
